description: Let this account send from another domain with the same key. First publish DNS TXT _sendforai.<domain> = "v=sfa1; delegate=<identity domain>" (if you have DNS access) or hand that record to your operator, then call this. If the record is not visible yet the response says exactly what to publish. Up to 50 domains, no fee; each keeps its own reputation and warmup.
name: add_domain
title: Add a sending domain
